probe: PROBE-A (Bring case): dim HH^1(H_5(q)) at the 5th root of unity
description: dim HH^1(H_5(q)) = dim Der - dim Inn at q = zeta_5 and zeta_10 (both [5]_q = 0, the n=5 non-semisimple locus), with a generic-q control and an n=3 regression against the merged hand-coded producer. Tests whether the fibre-level cyclotomic c_3 carrier has an outer-derivation source class.
method: Regular representation of balanced H_n(q) (T_i^2 = a T_i + 1, a = q - q^{-1}) built programmatically on the basis {T_w}; Der = nullspace of the Leibniz constraints imposed on D(T_i) by the quadratic, braid and commuting relations; Inn = n! - dim Z(A). Exact modular linear algebra over F_p with p = 1 mod 20.
rigour_note: All entries lie in Z[zeta]; reduction mod a prime above p is a ring homomorphism so rank_p <= rank_0, hence dim HH^1_p >= dim HH^1_0. A modular value of 0 therefore PROVES the characteristic-0 value is 0. A nonzero modular value is only an upper bound.
verdict: route survives: outer class exists at the Bring root; bar-parity test is the next gate.
